boundary_note: Bounded first pass within the complete frozen Eastern Kentucky campaign. Opening populations and replacement boundaries remain unestablished. Retrospective assertions and later pursuit context supply no admitted features or causal scores.

claims.value: Garfield’s January 11 report describes leaving with 1,100 men, receiving 700 reinforcements and opposing 2,500. His January 14 account instead says no more than 900 of his men were actually engaged and at least 3,500 enemies were present.
claims.rationale: Separate departure, reinforcement and engagement populations; opposing-force estimates change across the same author’s reports. Neither report establishes matched opening strengths; do not sum them or choose a preferred estimate.

claims.value: Garfield says the arriving boat supplied only three days of hard bread for 1,500 men before his pursuit.
claims.rationale: This is provision capacity for the advance, not a troop return or a readiness score. His later forage shortage and withdrawal are subsequent context.

claims.value: Garfield says he initially supposed the enemy was on Abbott’s Creek and intended to cut off the retreat; he later sent 20 mounted men across the plain to draw fire and partly disclose the position.
claims.rationale: A retrospective account of his own belief and reconnaissance action, not independent proof of what either commander knew or a precisely synchronized clock.

claims.value: NPS attributes to Buell the instruction that Garfield force Marshall back into Virginia.
claims.rationale: A secondary summary of the directive, not the inspected original order. Later regional control is not a second modeled outcome.

claims.value: Garfield says he declined pursuit at darkness because his men on different hills might fire on each other.
claims.rationale: One attributed command decision; no automatic allocation of the whole outcome to Garfield or every listed commander, and no counterfactual effect estimate.

claims.value: The frozen table records 92 casualties (US 27; CS 65). Garfield reports 2 killed and 25 wounded on January 11, but 1 killed and 20 wounded, two since dead, on January 14.
claims.rationale: Same-author totals differ; later deaths must not be counted twice. Enemy casualty claims in the full report are unadjudicated, and no reliable reconciliation with the table is established.

open_questions: Reconcile opening populations only through a separately justified admission task; departure, engaged, reserve and late pursuit counts must stay distinct.
Original manuscripts, Confederate reports and print verification remain deferred after the one targeted report-recovery follow-up; OCR and source disagreements remain visible.
No adjudicated campaign contribution, replacement boundary or automatic credit to all listed commanders is established.
